question: Can either fixed UOT configuration replace Joint Flow as the next point-only Workflow C registration direction?

real_dataset_policy.consequence: A decision is unavailable regardless of favorable results; no real-data generalization claim is allowed.

fixed_configuration_policy: No sweep, no per-dataset or per-scenario tuning, and no safety-threshold changes.

comparison_rules.synthetic_noninferiority: UOT overall median EPE and median TRE must each be no greater than Joint; missingness-stratified failure rate may not exceed Joint; no foldover is allowed.
comparison_rules.strong_adoption: Requires all nine user-specified criteria and at least three usable real datasets.
